verdict.rationale: Baseten documents async inference on deployed models that returns a request ID and completes later via webhook or polling, and the docs say it suits batch work. The evidence shows no discount for async or batch versus real-time pricing; the only discount documented is for cached input tokens, which is a separate feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: a documented batch or async pricing discount versus real-time, a dedicated batch-job submission API (e.g. file-based batch), and independent corroboration.
